name: RAJESH RACHAKONDA
title: ==SOFTWARE QA TEAM LEAD==  |  SENIOR SOFTWARE TEST ENGINEER

sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.body: Accomplished ==Software QA Team Lead== and Senior Software Test Engineer with 18+ years of experience ==setting up test environments, designing test plans, and executing test cases== for mission-critical platforms. ==Expertise in functional, regression, integration, and UAT phases==. Proven ability to ==partner with automation teams==, analyze QA processes, and ==troubleshoot quality issues using Root Cause Analysis==. Demonstrated success delivering within Agile / DevOps environments and managing defect lifecycles.
